name: Mendeley Reference Manager
author: Elsevier Ltd.
summary: Simplify your referencing, accelerate your research
description: Mendeley Reference Manager simplifies your referencing so that you can spend more time researching. Store, search, organize, note, share and cite from just one reference library. Offering time saving efficiencies, Mendeley Reference Manager enables you to reduce your workload and advance your research goals.

versions.release_notes:
We have fixed:
- A bug in the “Reset Mendeley” process for Windows users

We have fixed:
- Introduced the ability to read on a single or double page view in the PDF reader
- Improved the PDF highlight colours and contrast, making them easier to see
- Fixed an issue where the highlight context menu would not appear when creating a highlight in a PDF

We have fixed:
- An issue where long author names would overlap in the authors filter
- An issue where drag and drop was engaged when trying to highlight text in a collection title

We have:
- redesigned the metadata panel to enhance its functionality and usability
We have fixed:
- a bug that caused a column to drag when attempting to resize it

We have:
- added a loading screen when opening PDFs
- enhanced the Reader tabs functionality to ensure that the header no longer displays “File Not Found” when switching between tabs after an idle period

We have:
- Improved the library search so that you can search for different metadata fields in one search query
- Improved the load speed of the library references when scrolling
- Improved the reliability of BibTeX exports for case proceedings.
We have fixed:
- an issue where users were unable to search within Smart Collections.
- an issue that caused the application to freeze when users added multiple references to groups simultaneously.

We have:
- enhanced PDF loading speed
- increased the speed of bulk actions
We have fixed:
- slight delay in displaying duplicate modals
- problems with copying citations to the clipboard
- grey screen issue on older desktop versions

We have added:
- A new ‘about’ modal to contain clarification if there is a newer version of the app available for download
We have fixed:
- An issue where the email address wasn’t being remembered when the sign in cookie had expired
- An issue causing some users to be signed out of the application automatically and frequently
- An issue where the zoom in PDFs was too sensitive for Mac users using the trackpad
- An issue that caused the bulk action to slow or crash when moving references to a collection or group
